steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
Select toolchain and allocate an isolated unbooted simulator
Prepare the same production integration
Build complete app for Simulator (no Apple account)
Verify actual simulator signature and Keychain identity
Boot the isolated simulator only after compilation
Install and launch the complete app in a fresh simulator
Install isolated public-document source for the actual picker
Add UI-only test target without changing production sources
Exercise first setup and local navigation in the real app
Verify the selected invalid document was not modified
Record installation and file-provider services on failure
Retain app stdout and crash reports from the actual test result
Export actual UI screenshots
Summarize actual compiler diagnostics
Run actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
Shut down only the simulator created by this job
Post Run actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
Complete job
